title: Recover Original Array From Doubled Array
description: An array `changed` was formed by taking an original array and adding twice each original value, then shuffling the result. Recover and return the original values in non-decreasing order. If no original array is possible, return an empty array. Input: `changed`. Output: the recovered sorted array or empty array.
hints: Sort or count values once, then process each candidate in a single pass.
Check duplicates, all-equal inputs, and boundary values for `k`.
